name: Gemini CLI
description: Google's Gemini CLI. Speaks ACP natively, but needs GEMINI_API_KEY: Google withdrew Sign-in-with-Google for Gemini Code Assist for individuals, so OAuth-authenticated installs now fail.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Gemini API key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Now required: Google rejects Sign-in-with-Google for Gemini Code Assist for individuals, so an OAuth-only install fails every request with 'This client is no longer supported'.
